name: patient-experience-command-center
description: Deploy the Patient Experience Command Center accelerator on your own Snowflake data in 4 phases (conformance-discover, conformance-review, derived-build, app-deploy). Maps your source (HCAHPS survey, comments, calls, grievances, callbacks, unit operations) to a conformance contract, generates the derived data product (native Cortex AISQL voice enrichment + a custom XGBoost detractor/grievance-risk model with SHAP) from templates, then bundles and deploys the Next.js command-center app on Snowflake App Runtime (SPCS).
